Renton Technologies is a technology-driven company focused on providing cutting-edge solutions in IT infrastructure, data security, digital automation, and business consulting. With a team of passionate technologists and domain experts, we help clients stay ahead of the curve in a rapidly changing digital world.
Founded with a vision to streamline IT processes, Renton began as a local provider focused on revolutionizing technology management in the Puget Sound area.

We have proudly served a diverse clientele, including startups, educational institutions, and large enterprises, helping them navigate the complexities of IT lifecycle management.
Mitigate data breaches and minimize liability with certified data erasure and secure asset handling at every stage of the IT lifecycle.
Stay ahead of regulatory requirements with audit-ready reporting and proven processes aligned to global data protection standards.
Streamline IT asset management with seamless, automated workflows for data erasure, tracking, and reporting—saving time and resources.
Support environmental responsibility by securely refurbishing and redeploying assets, promoting reuse and reducing electronic waste.
